title: Seeking Global Talents at All Levels - SIAT - 1068 Xueyuan Avenue, Shenzhen 518055 P. R. China job with Shenzhen Institutes of Advanced Technology (SIAT), Chinese Academy of Sciences（CAS) | 12866398
gist: Job advertisement from the Shenzhen Institutes of Advanced Technology (CAS) recruiting researchers at all levels, with applications closing 4 Jan 2027; it lists strategic fields and an extensive support package.

insights.claim: SIAT is recruiting globally at all levels (Distinguished PIs, PIs, Young Scientists under 40, postdocs up to age 35) with a closing date of 4 Jan 2027.
insights.speaker: Nature Biotechnology
insights.so_what: Shows China's continued active recruitment of international scientific talent.

insights.claim: SIAT's stated key strategic fields include advanced integration technology, advanced computing and digital engineering, biomedicine and biotechnology, brain cognition, synthetic biology, advanced materials, carbon-neutrality technology and scientific instrumentation.
insights.speaker: Nature Biotechnology
insights.so_what: Indicates where Chinese state research institutes are directing talent and funding.

insights.claim: The employer offers research funding, lab space, team-building support, talent housing and purchase subsidies, and schooling from kindergarten through junior high, as an inducement for overseas-trained researchers.
insights.speaker: Nature Biotechnology
insights.so_what: The package signals the intensity of competition for overseas talent.
